package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	checkpointRequestID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	checkpointStudentID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	checkpointPathID    = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
)

func TestLearningPathReplanCheckpointIsDeterministicAndDecodesExactCommand(t *testing.T) {
	request := checkpointCoursePlanRequest()
	command := checkpointReplan()
	first, err := NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(request, command, time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(request, command, time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 11, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.PayloadHash != second.PayloadHash || !bytes.Equal(first.Payload, second.Payload) ||
		first.ExpectedVersion != command.ExpectedVersion || first.PlannedResultCode != CoursePlanResultCreated ||
		first.PlannedCourseID != command.CourseID || first.PlannedReused {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint drifted: first=%#v second=%#v", first, second)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
		first, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
	)
	if err != nil || decoded.LearningPathID != command.LearningPathID || decoded.PlanningRequestID != request.ID ||
		decoded.ExpectedVersion != command.ExpectedVersion || len(decoded.Items) != len(command.Items) {
		t.Fatalf("decoded command changed: decoded=%#v err=%v", decoded, err)
	}
}

func TestLearningPathCommandCheckpointRejectsTamperingAndTrailingJSON(t *testing.T) {
	request := checkpointCoursePlanRequest()
	checkpoint, err := NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
		request, checkpointReplan(), time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*LearningPathCommandCheckpoint)
	}{
		{name: "expected version", mutate: func(item *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint) { item.ExpectedVersion++ }},
		{name: "planned outcome", mutate: func(item *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint) { item.PlannedReused = true }},
		{name: "hash", mutate: func(item *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint) {
			item.PayloadHash = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
		}},
		{name: "payload", mutate: func(item *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint) { item.Payload = append(item.Payload, []byte(` {}`)...) }},
		{name: "malformed trailing payload", mutate: func(item *LearningPathCommandCheckpoint) { item.Payload = append(item.Payload, []byte(` x`)...) }},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			changed := checkpoint
			changed.Payload = append([]byte(nil), checkpoint.Payload...)
			testCase.mutate(&changed)
			if _, err := NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
				changed, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
			); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected tampered checkpoint to fail")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLearningPathNoGapCheckpointBindsExactPathAndVersion(t *testing.T) {
	request := checkpointCoursePlanRequest()
	request.ResultCode = CoursePlanResultNoGap
	request.CourseID = ""
	command := LearningPathCompletion{
		Schema: LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema, LearningPathID: request.LearningPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: request.ID, GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap",
		ReasonSummary: "All exact targets are mastered", ExpectedVersion: 7,
	}
	checkpoint, err := NewLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
		request, command, time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
		checkpoint, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
	)
	if err != nil || checkpoint.Command != LearningPathCommandNoGap || decoded.ExpectedVersion != 7 ||
		decoded.LearningPathID != request.LearningPathID || checkpoint.PlannedResultCode != CoursePlanResultNoGap ||
		checkpoint.PlannedCourseID != "" || checkpoint.PlannedReused {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected no-gap checkpoint: checkpoint=%#v decoded=%#v err=%v", checkpoint, decoded, err)
	}
}

func checkpointCoursePlanRequest() CoursePlanRequest {
	return CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: checkpointRequestID, StudentID: checkpointStudentID, LearningPathID: checkpointPathID,
		ResultCode: CoursePlanResultCreated, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
	}
}

func checkpointReplan() LearningPathReplan {
	return LearningPathReplan{
		Schema: LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: checkpointPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: checkpointRequestID, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "mastery_replan",
		ReasonSummary: "Refresh exact route", ExpectedVersion: 7,
		Items: []LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			Status: LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []TargetRef{{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}},
			ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}
}
